content.text: All budget tests pass, including the subtle chunk-line counting point. Now strict input validation:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_input.py << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def base(**over):
    d = {'seed': 's', 'definitions': [], 'timeout_ms': 5,
         'cases': [], 'events': [], 'channels': []}
    d.update(over)
    return d

def case(name='c', frames=None, expect=None):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames or [],
            'expect': expect or {'method': 'GET', 'target': '/a', 'host': 'h'}}

def is_err(r):
    return r == {'error': 'input'}

# ---- raw JSON strictness --------------------------------------------------
check('duplicate root key', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"s","seed":"t"}')))
check('duplicate frame key', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':1,'Time_to_Stop':2}])]))))
check('duplicate headers_kv key', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'headers','headers_kv':{'a':'b','a':'c'}}])]))))
check('BOM rejected', is_err(run_raw('\ufeff' + '{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('trailing values', is_err(run_raw('{} {}')))
check('trailing junk', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]} x')))
check('NaN', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":NaN,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('Infinity', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":Infinity,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('overflowing exponent', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1e400,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('float number', is_err(run_obj(base(timeout_ms=1.0))))
check('float exponent int-valued', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1e1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('bool as int', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':True}])]))))
check('lone surrogate', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"\\ud800","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('surrogate in template', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'data','data_to_transfered':'a\\ud800b'}])]))))
check('invalid utf8', is_err(run_raw(b'{"seed":"\xff","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')))
check('empty input', is_err(run_raw('')))
check('not an object', is_err(run_raw('[]')))
check('unknown root key', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[],"x":1}')))
check('missing root key', is_err(run_raw('{"seed":"","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[]}')))
check('huge int', is_err(run_obj(base(timeout_ms=10**30))))
check('negative zero ok-or-int', run_obj(base(timeout_ms=-0)) != {'error': 'input'})  # -0 is integer 0 -> out of range
check('negative zero rejected', is_err(run_obj(base(timeout_ms=-0))))

# ---- seed / names ---------------------------------------------------------
check('seed 64 ok', run_obj(base(seed='a'*64)) != {'error': 'input'})
check('seed 65 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(seed='a'*65))))
check('seed bad char', is_err(run_obj(base(seed='a b'))))
check('seed empty ok', run_obj(base(seed='')) != {'error': 'input'})
check('case name empty', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='')]))) )
check('case name 32 ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a'*32)])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('case name 33 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a'*33)]))))
check('case name bad char', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a/b')]))) )
check('case name leading digit ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='9a')])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('case duplicate name', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='c'), case(name='c')]))))
check('channel dup name', is_err(run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'c','parts':[]},{'name':'c','parts':[]}]))))
check('channel bad name', is_err(run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'','parts':[]}]))))

# ---- expect ---------------------------------------------------------------
for bad in [{'method':'GE T','target':'/a','host':'h'},
            {'method':'GET','target':'/a','host':'h','x':1},
            {'method':'GET','target':'/a'},
            {'method':'GET','target':'/a','host':''},
            {'method':'GET','target':' ','host':'h'},
            {'method':'','target':'/a','host':'h'},
            {'method':'GéT','target':'/a','host':'h'},
            {'method':'GET','target':'/a\tb','host':'h'}]:
    check('expect ' + str(bad)[:40], is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(expect=bad)]))))
check('expect ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(expect={'method':'GET!','target':'/a#b','host':'H'})])) != {'error': 'input'})

# ---- frames ---------------------------------------------------------------
bad_frames = [
    [],                                                    # valid: empty
]
errs = [
    [{'Type':'headers'}],                                   # neither field
    [{'Type':'headers','headers_kv':{},'data_to_transfered':[]}],
    [{'Type':'headers','headers_kv':[], 'End_Stream': True}],
    [{'Type':'headers','data_to_transfered':[["a"]]}],
    [{'Type':'headers','data_to_transfered':[["a","b","c"]]}],
    [{'Type':'headers','data_to_transfered':[["a", 1]]}],
    [{'Type':'headers','headers_kv':{'a':'b'},'End_Stream':1}],
    [{'Type':'headers','headers_kv':{'a':'b'},'End_Stream':True,'extra':1}],
    [{'Type':'data'}],
    [{'Type':'data','data_to_transfered':5}],
    [{'Type':'datagram','data_to_transfered':'x','End_Stream':3}],
    [{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':-1}],
    [{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':2**63}],
    [{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':1,'End_Stream':True}],
    [{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':1.0}],
    [{'Type':'bogus','data_to_transfered':'x'}],
    [{'Type':'Headers','data_to_transfered':'x'}],
    [{'data_to_transfered':'x'}],
    ['x'],
]
for i, fr in enumerate(errs):
    check('bad frame %d' % i, is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=fr)]))))
check('frame 128 pairs ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'headers','data_to_transfered':[[str(i),'v'] for i in range(128)]]})])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('frame 129 pairs bad', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'headers','data_to_transfered':[[str(i),'v'] for i in range(129)]]})]))))
check('kv 129 pairs bad', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'headers','headers_kv':{str(i):'v' for i in range(129)}}])]))))
check('sleep max ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':2**63-1}])])) != {'error': 'input'})

# time overflow: pauses + timeout
check('pause+timeout overflow', is_err(run_obj(base(timeout_ms=2, cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':2**63-1}])]))))
check('pause+timeout max ok', run_obj(base(timeout_ms=1, cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':2**63-1}])])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('unused frames validated', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(frames=[{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':1}, {'Type':'bogus'}])]))))

# ---- events ---------------------------------------------------------------
bad_events = [
    {'at':1,'kind':'close','stream':0,'end':True},
    {'at':1,'kind':'bogus'},
    {'at':1,'kind':'close','x':1},
    {'at':-1,'kind':'close'},
    {'at':2**63,'kind':'close'},
    {'at':True,'kind':'close'},
    {'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,'fields':[]},
    {'at':1,'kind':'data','stream':0,'end':True},
    {'at':1,'kind':'data','stream':2**32,'data':'x','end':True},
    {'at':1,'kind':'data','stream':-1,'data':'x','end':True},
    {'at':1,'kind':'data','stream':0,'data':'x','end':1},
    {'at':1,'kind':'data','stream':0,'data':5,'end':True},
    {'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,'fields':[['a']]},
    {'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,'fields':[['a','b','c']]},
    {'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,'fields':[1]},
]
for i, ev in enumerate(bad_events):
    check('bad event %d' % i, is_err(run_obj(base(events=[ev]))))
check('event 128 fields ok', run_obj(base(events=[{'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,
      'fields':[[str(i),'v'] for i in range(128)]}])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('event 129 fields bad', is_err(run_obj(base(events=[{'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,
      'fields':[[str(i),'v'] for i in range(129)]}]))))
check('events out of order ok', run_obj(base(events=[{'at':5,'kind':'close'},{'at':1,'kind':'close'}])) != {'error': 'input'})

# ---- channels -------------------------------------------------------------
check('bad part keys', is_err(run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':None,'data':'x','y':1}]}]))))
check('owner unknown', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case()], channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':'nope','data':'x'}]}]))))
check('owner not string', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case()], channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':5,'data':'x'}]}]))))
check('part data not string', is_err(run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':None,'data':5}]}]))))
check('owner ok null', run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':None,'data':'x'}]}])) != {'error': 'input'})

# ---- budgets ---------------------------------------------------------------
check('definitions 8192 ok', run_obj(base(definitions=[['d%d' % i, "b'x'"] for i in range(8192)])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('definitions 8193 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(definitions=[['d%d' % i, "b'x'"] for i in range(8193)]))))
check('cases 2000 ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='c%d' % i) for i in range(2000)])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('cases 2001 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='c%d' % i) for i in range(2001)]))))
check('channels 256 ok', run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z%d' % i,'parts':[]} for i in range(256)])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('channels 257 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z%d' % i,'parts':[]} for i in range(257)]))))
# combined frames+events+parts
frames = [{'Type':'sleep','Time_to_Stop':0}] * 20000
evs = [{'at':1,'kind':'close'}] * 20000
parts = [{'case':None,'data':'x'}] * 10000
check('combined 50000 ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a', frames=frames), case(name='b', frames=frames)],
      events=evs, channels=[{'name':'z','parts':parts}])) != {'error': 'input'})
parts = [{'case':None,'data':'x'}] * 10001
check('combined 50001 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a', frames=frames), case(name='b', frames=frames)],
      events=evs, channels=[{'name':'z','parts':parts}]))))
# combined header pairs 32768
def pair_frames(total):
    out = []
    left = total
    while left > 0:
        k = min(128, left)
        out.append({'Type':'headers','headers_kv':{('k%d' % j):'v' for j in range(k)}})
        left -= k
    return out
check('pairs 32768 ok', run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a', frames=pair_frames(32768))])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('pairs 32769 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a', frames=pair_frames(32769))]))))
check('pairs events+frames', is_err(run_obj(base(cases=[case(name='a', frames=pair_frames(32768))],
      events=[{'at':1,'kind':'headers','stream':0,'end':True,'fields':[['a','b']]}]))))
# stdin limit handled by main; template source budgets
check('template 65536 ok', run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':None,'data':'x'*65536}]}])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('template 65537 bad', is_err(run_obj(base(channels=[{'name':'z','parts':[{'case':None,'data':'x'*65537}]}]))))

# event stream range boundary
check('stream 2^32-1 ok', run_obj(base(events=[{'at':1,'kind':'data','stream':2**32-1,'data':'x','end':True}])) != {'error': 'input'})
check('at 2^63-1 ok', run_obj(base(events=[{'at':2**63-1,'kind':'close'}])) != {'error': 'input'})

summary()
